tools_used: CourtListener MCP (search, call_endpoint, get_endpoint_item, read_document, search_document)
helpful: Provisioned petition, BIO and questions-presented text: the party-presentation concession and the 12(b)(6) posture came straight from the BIO
Statpack CVSG cut and sal-v4 high-band reached rate agreeing at ~35%: a stable anchor
Live supremecourt.gov docket via WebFetch: confirmed no SG brief and no disposition as of run date
Public B.P.J. summaries: established what the same-day decision did and did not resolve
gaps: fedcourts query has no --cvsg or --band filter, and its ranking returned recent emergency applications rather than comparable CVSG'd cert petitions; a 'CVSG'd petitions from the last N Terms with disposition and SG-recommendation' pull would be the natural prior set for this moment
CourtListener carries no docket entries for SCOTUS dockets and had no text for the B.P.J. opinion (cluster 10882186), so the merits signal had to come from the open web

No published cut of grant rate conditional on the SG's eventual recommendation; the relist and CVSG cuts bucket by terminal state, so the forward hazard from a CVSG-just-issued state is inferred rather than read
notes: Two corpus queries ran (granted / denied, era 2020s); the first reported 47 GETs and ~12.3 MB, the second 0 GETs from the warm cache. Roughly 16 retrieval calls in total, within the advisory budget. The CRS report on B.P.J. returned HTTP 403 to WebFetch; Wikipedia and NCLR pages were used instead.
